name: Fuchsia Bloom Fascinator

images.alt: Fuchsia Bloom Fascinator – handmade girls outfit, made to order in Pakistan

description: A bright pink party headpiece styled with a round mesh base and a wide net flare. The center features three rolled satin roses in soft peach, purple, and dark pink, each finished with a shiny crystal accent in the middle and framed by soft, colorful feathers.
description2: It is lightweight, easy to clip into hair, and adds a fun, dressy touch to any party look. This hairpiece can be customized in any color to perfectly match your dress.
